newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London ease in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London ease in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London on Tuesday were to steady to weaker but trading volumes were low as investors remained on the sidelines during London's summer holiday period, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index fell 16.69 points to close at 15,755.37, after the Hang Seng index climbed 105.47 points to a record closing high of 15,772.06.
"The Hong Kong market historically has periods of consolidation and that is what we are in now," said one dealer. "And with so many people away in London, there is very little interest."

However, shares in Hopewell Holdings featured as the company's Bangkok mass transit project appeared to be weighed down after unpaid contractors stopped work and talks with the Thai government reached an impasse. Hopewell shares dropped 7-1/2 cents to HK$4.40.
